savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14009 in full (secs. 1-5): sec. 4(a) revoked EO 13765 (Minimizing the Economic Burden of the PPACA Pending Repeal) and EO 13813 (Promoting Healthcare Choice and Competition), effective on signing 2021-01-28, a completed act on other orders. EO 14148 sec. 2(t) revokes EO 14009 without revival wording, and revoking a revoking order does not by itself revive the orders it revoked, so those two stay revoked: an effect of EO 14009 survives it (accrued). Secs. 2, 3 and 4(b) only direct HHS and other agency heads to consider or review; any Special Enrollment Period, rule or waiver adopted under them rests on the cited statutes and regulations (42 U.S.C. 18031 and 18041; 45 CFR 155.420(d)(9)) and on EO 14148 sec. 3(b)'s review process, not on a right the order created; sec. 5(c) disclaims private rights. No function, fund or property was transferred. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) OVERRULED to transferred_or_accrued because of the completed revocations. Bounded search: every held official FR text (jobs/fr-originals, EO 1 through EO 14435) was grepped for the order's number and read where it appeared; OFR catalog edges (jobs/later-events EDGES.csv), the dossier's current-law leads (none) and the three machine searches were read.

research_rationale: EO 14009 (signed 2021-01-28, 86 FR 7793-7795), read in full from the held official FR text, states the ACA/Medicaid policy (sec. 1), asks HHS to consider a Special Enrollment Period (sec. 2), orders agency review (sec. 3), revokes EO 13765 and EO 13813 and orders review of related agency actions (sec. 4) and has general provisions (sec. 5). It has no term or sunset; the 'emergency continues' words in sec. 2 are a recital. EO 14148 sec. 2(t) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes it with no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20. The dossier clauses began at sec. 3 and omitted secs. 1 and 2, so the inventory was corrected to ten clauses. Dossier missing lines read: (1) EO 14070 (87 FR 20689, read in full) says it acts 'in addition to' EO 14009 and recites agency actions taken under it; it amends, extends or ends no provision of EO 14009, so it is ruled out as a later event. (2) EO 14177 (read in full) does not name EO 14009. The OFR catalog record for EO 14009 lists 'Supersedes EO 14048', 'EO 14084' and 'See EO 14177', and the record for EO 14177 lists 'EO 14009, September 29, 2023'; those are EO 14109's acts (held EO 14109 sec. 3 supersedes EO 14048 secs. 1-2, sec. 5 amends EO 14084, signed 2023-09-29) printed under a mistyped number, and EO 14109 never names EO 14009, so they are ruled out. Only EO 14148 names EO 14009 as a target among the held texts after 2021. Savings: completed revocations accrue (see savings reason).
